given: a SKU's detail view is showing its stock at a location
when: the warehouse team member reads that location's entry
then: the combined inventory_code (tracking code) recorded for that stock is shown alongside it

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts the per-location rows (location + quantity) appear; AC2 asserts the distinct outcome that each entry surfaces its combined inventory_code. The tracking code can be absent while location/quantity rows render, and rows can be missing while a rendered entry still shows its code, so each fails independently.

architectural_notes: E2E: extends the same detail read path; the repository must select inventory_code (a NOT NULL column, PI2) alongside location/quantity and the service must carry it through the DTO to the boundary JSON so the React entry renders it. No new persistence. Cross-cutting: the field is part of the read projection owned by the repository/service, not synthesized in the component. Verified real-branch (NFR-F1-4): seed a stock record with a known inventory_code, assert the detail entry shows that code beside its location.
